images.scene: Robinson drives a small herd of young goats into a freshly built fenced enclosure in a clearing surrounded by thick woods, hammering stakes and weaving branches into the fence.
images.alt: A man pens goats inside a wooden fence in a woodland clearing.

images.scene: Robinson stands alone on a bare hill at the western point of the island, shading his eyes as he stares out at a tiny distant speck that might be a boat far out on the open sea.
images.alt: A man on a hilltop peers out to sea at a distant speck on the horizon.

images.scene: A lonely beach at the island's southwest point strewn with scattered human skulls and bones, with the burnt-out ring of a fire pit dug in the sand where cannibals had feasted.
images.alt: A deserted shore littered with human bones around a dug fire pit.

images.scene: Robinson stands ready for the road in his goat-skin clothes, two pistols and a slung cutlass without a scabbard hanging from his belt, his gun over his shoulder, looking a formidable figure.
images.alt: A castaway armed with two pistols, a sword and a gun stands ready.

images.scene: Inside a dark rock cave Robinson holds a blazing firebrand above his head, its light revealing a huge old he-goat lying gasping on the cave floor, its eyes shining in the gloom.
images.alt: A man raises a burning torch in a cave, lighting an old goat lying on the ground.

images.scene: Robinson crouches inside a lofty vaulted grotto deep in the rock, holding two candles whose flames make the crystalline walls and roof sparkle with countless reflected points of light.
images.alt: A man holding candles in a cave whose walls glitter with reflected light.
